Performers
Odeon Grand Orchestra (orchestra) Disputed: sources disagree

Internet Archive and the 2015 Science Museum article attribute the record to Kark in 1910. James Hepokoski’s publisher-deposited 2023 abstract dates the Odeon Fifth to August 1911 and infers Künneke because the labels name no conductor. The full article was unavailable; the older attribution is retained as a documented dispute.

  • Odeon Grand Orchestra; Friedrich Kark, conductor — older attribution
  • Odeon company orchestra; Eduard Künneke, conductor — Hepokoski’s inference, not named on the original labels

Full article returned 403 and was not read.. Accessed 2026-10-17.
